priorities: Review and update priorities in project-state.json
notes: 40 SCs discovered from specs. Organize into phases as project evolves.

scs.what: Short version 75-125 words and long version under 200 words both generated
Three paragraphs maximum
Opener uses a timeline hook rather than a problem hook
Exactly one CTA, and it is not a scheduling link
The attached one-pager is referenced in one sentence
Opener cites an externally observable signal
Body states a point of view rather than product features
The POV corrects a misunderstanding or connects unconnected dots
Peer reference names one company and one metric
Peer reference differs across personas at the same account
Reading level is 3rd grade or simpler
Email matches the owning AE's voice profile when one exists
Draft passes every line of the AI-tell checklist
Follow-up cadence of 3-7-7 days is included
No ask exceeds 20 minutes
Renders to exactly one page
Copy is between 200 and 350 words
Sections follow Environment, Insight, Convergence, Path Forward
A convergence thesis connects 2-3 named initiatives
Key terms are bolded inline rather than placed in cards
Headline sits top-left and next steps sit bottom-right
Credibility signals are logos or named references, not stock photography
Page contains both a convergence callout and a capability table
Margins and spacing leave the page uncrowded
No date stamp or file name appears in the header or footer
Text reads from the buyer's perspective throughout
Exactly one objection is pre-answered
Every claim carries a number or a named company
One honest limitation is stated plainly
PDF opens with no login, form, or gate
Two or three initiatives are framed as one challenge
A convergence callout box is visually dominant
A two-column diagram shows the product bridging the initiatives
Customer initiatives are named by their internal program names
AI-tell checklist completed with no unresolved items
Creepy-line check finds no internal-systems data
Competitor-swap test fails, proving the POV is not a brochure
Print preview shows no bleed onto a second page
Email is readable on mobile without scrolling
One-pager stands alone when read without the email
